premises.text: Kids need to be taught how to engage and disengage with social media the way we teach other life skills, because current platforms harm them
premises.evidence_span: They need to be taught how to engage and how to disengage with technology, just like we teach them to read, to add and subtract, to think critically, even how we teach them to drive

premises.text: Betweened provides kid-friendly creation, guided social communication, parental stage-gated tools, and expert-moderated content with consent
premises.evidence_span: Between features, kid-friendly versions of the creator tools that we see on major platforms

premises.text: Grow via content beta, parent networking, brand partnerships, then invitation-based social features
premises.evidence_span: we'll begin doing good old-fashioned networking with parents and leveraging brand partnerships so that we continue to grow Between

value.text: Course-correct social media so kids grow up thoughtful and practiced
value.evidence_span: Betweened is how we course correct social media for kids around the world

secondary_value.text: Deepen emotional bonds through creating together

causal_links.evidence_span: Social media doesn't have to be bad when it's leveraged as part of a balanced social media diet

notes: Problem list of platform harms folded into teaching-need premise. Product features including moderation folded into one platform premise.
